title: Separate finite-level markings of a normalized algebraic stalk tower
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, d an adic coefficient datum on A, and M a derived module over the completed coefficient sheaf. Assume finite quotient constant functors preserve zero morphisms, and fix isomorphisms φ from constant quotient ring sheaves to finite coefficient sheaves compatible with quotient maps and the completed scalar map. Suppose M has uniform finite perfect quotient models [lem-weil-pbc-residue-perfect-finite-quotient-models]. There is an etale cover V_i of X and, for each i, a normalized algebraic tower T_i [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-tower-data] all of whose levels are perfect. For each n separately there is an etale covering sieve of V_i on which the actual quotient M_n is isomorphic to finite coefficient realization of T_i.level n. The markings need not be compatible in n and no common pro-etale cover is asserted.

source.place: Tag 09C6, lemma-connected-adic-lisse, the paragraph constructing normalized algebraic M_n before taking their limit; Tags 09AL, 09B1 and 094G.

proof.text: Apply finitePerfectAdic_etale_stalk_data to obtain an etale cover, perfect algebraic stalk levels and their consecutive scalar-extension isomorphisms, bounded finite-lisse descended etale levels, and coefficient transport conditional on a supplied local stalk isomorphism. No normalized tower or marking sieve is supplied by this step.

Use the actual derived module scalar adjunctions along A to A/I^(n+1) and A/I^(n+2) to A/I^(n+1). Define each transition as the adjoint transpose of the given consecutive reduction isomorphism. The hom-equivalence inverse law identifies its transpose with that isomorphism, proving normalization. Package these functors, adjunctions and transitions, with perfect residue, into FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower.

For each chart and each level separately, install the finiteness of A/I^(n+1) from the datum. Apply the connected-chart clause of finiteRing_derived_local_constancy to the descended level and the algebraic-closure point specified in the data. This gives an etale cover carrying the required isomorphisms with that exact derived geometric stalk.

Compose each level-cover arrow with its chart map to regard it as an object of X.Etale. Form Sieve.ofArrows. Joint surjectivity of the level-cover proves membership in smallEtaleTopology via ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff. Every arrow in this sieve factors through one generating object; apply the conditional coefficient transport to its local stalk isomorphism and this factorization. Retain the constructed normalized algebraic tower and its levelwise perfectness.

theorem finitePerfectAdic_stalk_models
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d))
    (hmodels : HasUniformFinitePerfectModels X d φ M) :
    ∃ 𝒱 : Cover.{t} etalePrecoverage X, ∀ i : 𝒱.I₀,
      ∃ T : FinitePerfectAdicAlgebraTower d,
        (∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory.IsPerfect (T.level n)) ∧
        FinitePerfectAdicLevelMarkings X d φ M (𝒱.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) T
